scenarios.name: Hide and restore a View ribbon panel

scenario_steps.name: the View ribbon is expanded with Visibility, Appearance, Windows and Navigate visible
the user opens the View ribbon context menu and expand Show Panels
Visibility, Appearance, Windows and Navigate are checked
the user selects Navigate in Show Panels
the Navigate panel disappears from the View ribbon
the user switches to 3D Model and returns to View
the user reopens Show Panels on the View ribbon
the user selects Navigate in Show Panels
the Navigate panel reappears on the View ribbon
